name: Ontology (KY)
sale: Fasig-Tipton October (FTKOCT), Hip 198, Yearling — consigned by Hunter Valley Farm, bought by Blue Bird Stables for $90,000. First RNA’d at Keeneland September (Hip 439) on a $120,000 reserve.
notes: By Kitten's Joy out of Hidden Message, by Scat Daddy. Bred by Qatar Racing, LLC. Trainer Brendan Walsh early on, moved to Kevin Attard's barn (Woodbine) mid-2026. Career: 8 starts, 2-0-2, $87,663 against a $90,000 yearling buy (after RNA'ing at a $120,000 reserve at Keeneland September first). Full progression: rough 2yo campaign (5th, 7th in her first two, both as a short-priced runner), found her stride at 3 with back-to-back thirds, broke through for the maiden win at Fair Grounds in January 2026, ran flat (8th, last) in her stakes debut in March, then a flat 5th in her first Woodbine start for Attard before a standout last-to-first sweep to win going away in August.

log.text: Ellis Park, Maiden Special Weight, 1 1/16m turf — career debut, 5th beaten a head for 4th as the 4.66 second choice. Brushed at the start, saved ground back of the pack, shifted out five wide in upper stretch for a belated kick.

Kentucky Downs, Maiden Special Weight, 1m turf — 7th as the 2.96 favorite off her debut effort. Unhurried early, raced three wide through the far turn, swung out six wide into the lane and couldn't sustain the bid.
Fair Grounds, Maiden Special Weight, 1m turf — 3rd, beaten a head for 2nd, at 5.50. Settled off the pace four wide, rallied seven wide through the far turn, pressed late but had no closing bid.
Fair Grounds, Maiden Special Weight, 1 1/16m turf — 3rd, beaten 3 1/2, at 9.40. Off the pace early, rallied along the inside in the stretch for the show award.

Fair Grounds, Maiden Special Weight, 1 1/16m turf — first career win, by 1 1/2 as the 4.00 second choice. Cued four wide in the far turn, saved ground into the stretch, took over at the eighth and drew off.

Fair Grounds, Allen Black Cat LaCombe Memorial S. (Black Type), 1 1/16m turf — 8th (last), stakes debut, sent off at 9.90. Saved ground early, no factor in the stretch — the step up in class didn’t suit.

Woodbine, Allowance Optional Claiming, 1 1/16m all-weather — 5th beaten 5 1/2 as the 10.50 chance. First start for the Attard barn. Settled off the pace inside, angled five to six wide turning for home, kept on late but never got competitive.

Woodbine, Allowance Optional Claiming, 1 1/16m all-weather — won by 1 1/2 as the 4.00 chance. Dead last early and unhurried, angled five wide at the top of the stretch and swept past the whole field in the lane, picking horses off one by one to win going away. Best performance of her career.
